name: limit_anchor_on_the_chamfer_border
why: ENTRY E18, risk 9 of the critic. The edge between the front face and a chamfer passes all the other checks: it lies in the plane of the face, it is straight, it runs along the right axis. But it is the border of the chamfer, and if the chamfer goes from 5 to 8 the hole moves by 3 without anyone knowing. We look at the OTHER face of the edge: it must be planar and perpendicular to the one being worked on. Measured on 25/9/2026 with the bench probe.

message_includes: on the border of a chamfer or a fillet
